_comment: CUDA <-> NVIDIA driver compatibility data used by `altatts doctor`. THIS IS DATA, NOT CODE: driver/CUDA rules change over time. Update from `source` and bump last_verified; the doctor warns when the table is older than six months. Semantics: a torch build against CUDA major M runs on any driver >= min_driver_linux[M] (CUDA minor-version compatibility). A 12.1 build on a 12.4-capable driver is FINE. torch_wheel_tags: the CUDA tags published at https://download.pytorch.org/whl/<tag>/ (doctor --fix probes those within the driver ceiling and GPU floor). min_cuda_for_compute_cap: the oldest CUDA whose torch builds contain this compute capability (keys are 'major' or 'major.minor').
